name: Gideon Pell
silhouette: Broad, waistcoat straining, Company-green sash, brass speaking trumpet he does not need.
speech_rhythm: Long, rolling, three adjectives where one would do. Announces the player: 'Keeper!'
public_motivation: A glorious Jubilee and record traffic.
private_motivation: To be remembered; a Board seat.
contradiction: Loves the canal and town sincerely and causes half its floods.
secret: Reviving the Clearance Order draft 'as a contingency'.
